findings.title: Mobile event note obscures and intercepts reserve action
findings.expected_behavior: Reserve button label, target, and focus must be visible and normally operable at narrow width.
findings.observed_behavior: Fixed event note covers almost all of the reserve button. Normal click times out with p.event-note intercepting pointer events. Keyboard focus is mostly hidden. Keyboard activation still works.
reproduction: Attempt normal click on Reserve my seat
Observe intercepted pointer and obscured label; Tab to inspect obscured focus
findings.proposed_smallest_correction: Return event note to normal flow, or allocate separate nonoverlapping space for note and fixed button; preserve accepted styling.

findings.title: Desktop hero date overlaps title
findings.expected_behavior: Title and date/time are independently legible.
findings.observed_behavior: Date/time text crosses the bottom title line at desktop width.
reproduction: Inspect the hero title and date before scrolling
findings.proposed_smallest_correction: Remove negative desktop date spacing and provide normal-flow separation below title while preserving gradient and typography.
